t2i_prompt: Flat UI mockup, no device frame, of a long web page for <CONTENT> on a deep navy blueprint ground. Light off-white paper drawing sheets are inset for reading sections, each with a thin inner border, a title block and a sheet number in the bottom-right corner. Hero directly on navy: thin light uppercase title, white isometric line drawing of an industrial equipment skid, stacked mono figures and one steel-blue button. Between sheets, a horizontal process chain of square glyph boxes with arrows sits on the navy. Hairline tables, a parameter grid and an accordion with a sand-beige open row. 1 px lines, square corners, no shadows, generous margins.
signature_idea: Reading sections are numbered drawing sheets with title blocks, laid onto a navy blueprint page.
strengths: gives a clear, buildable rule: navy ground for drawings, framed light sheets for reading
sheet numbers and title blocks tie into footer and nav language
isometric skid drawing is a credible, ownable hero visual
light headlines and mono figures on brand
weaknesses: orange vignette glow at the edges is an off-brand rendering artifact
left legend column of blank panels is confusing
beige accordion highlight adds a second neutral
table and grid text is illegible gibberish at this scale
brand_fit_why: Navy ground, limestone sheets, one steel-blue accent, light headlines, mono figures, square corners and calm space are exactly the brand book; only the orange vignette is off.
